summary: Bit Origin Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of two directors (Mei Yeung and Siyuan Zhuang) and the appointment of two replacements (Mei Ting Yeung and Wei Li), effective July 10, 2026. The resignations were not due to any disagreement with the company. The changes appear orderly, with the new appointees having relevant accounting and investment banking experience. No price, premium, or deal terms are involved. This is a non-US filing equivalent to a current report on Form 8-K regarding director changes. The event is a routine board refreshment; there is no activist campaign or other special situation. Watch for any subsequent filings indicating strategic shifts.
